remarks: Prime Corner Lot in Desirable HazeldeanExceptional redevelopment opportunity in the highly sought-after community of Hazeldean. This large corner lot measures 65 ft x 138 ft, offering approximately 9,067 sq. ft. of land.The property currently features an older home, presently configured as an office, along with a 24 ft x 24 ft detached garage. Its prime location provides easy access to shopping, schools, parks, public transit, and other everyday amenities, with transit service conveniently located right outside the property.Under Edmontons new zoning bylaws, the site is eligible for a development of up to eight units. Given the lots substantial size, there may also be potential to obtain approval for two or three additional units, subject to municipal review and approval.Whether youre a developer, investor, or builder, this is a rare opportunity to secure a large infill site in one of Edmontons most desirable mature neighbourhoods.Buyer to verify all development potential and zoning requirements with the municipality.
